prompt: Edit paint_mask_guide.png exactly, using design_reference.png as material/detail reference and icon_x8.png as original colour reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta). Produce ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 (3:4). Preserve exact guide silhouette positions, sizes, outlines, openings and view orientations. The guide is three columns by FOUR rows of 512px cells: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty, repeated in rows 3–4. Paint only existing grey objects; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign. Object is Iron Ring: source-faithful upright hoop plane. Rows 1–2 PAINT: unlit base colour, worn mottled warm brass/iron and dark tarnished grey metal as reference, detail scaled to views, no invented ornaments. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow design reference where present. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text. Rows 3–4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure #FF0000 for every metal part; #000000 only for gemstones/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid through glass. This ring is entirely metal so all five lower silhouettes must be solid pure red, NO shading, texture, outlines or interior antialiased colour blends. Every silhouette pixel receives exactly one colour. All outside pixels and all gaps/holes fully transparent; column 3 of rows 2 and 4 empty transparent. Guide geometry and layout are authoritative over the reference perspective.
